label: EXPLORATORY (docs/RAG_V2_CRITERIA.md section 8)
prompt:
/no_think
You help a search engine connect EU law with business processes.

Below is one passage of EU law. Write 1 or 2 short sentences in plain business language that say when this passage
applies in a business process: which kind of business, which step or situation (for example taking an order, sending
an invoice, paying a supplier, delivering goods, handling a return, collecting customer data), and who is involved.

Rules:
- Use everyday business words, not legal terms. Do not name directives, articles or numbers.
- Say only what the passage supports. Do not add obligations that are not in the passage.
- Write only the 1 or 2 sentences. No list, no heading, no other text.

Passage:
Consumer Rights Directive (2011/83/EU) - Article 18: Delivery
1. Unless the parties have agreed otherwise on the time of delivery, the trader shall deliver the goods by transferring the physical possession or control of the goods to the consumer without undue delay, but not later than 30 days from the conclusion of the contract.
raw_output: When a business sells goods online or in person, they must hand over the physical items to the customer within 30 days of the sale. This applies when the customer has ordered goods and the business is responsible for delivering them.
enrichment: When a business sells goods online or in person, they must hand over the physical items to the customer within 30 days of the sale. This applies when the customer has ordered goods and the business is responsible for delivering them.
